title: What the Decoder Computes and What the Benchmark Scores: Two Implementation Defects in a Reference End-to-End Driving Stack: code and results
description:
Code and results accompanying the paper. Contains the one-line correction for the occupancy coordinate-truncation defect in UniAD's planning decoder, magnitude-matched direction controls (mirror, negation, uniform-random rotation), a magnitude-matched allocation control, and the audit showing why an earlier retention-permuting allocation control is confounded and withdrawn, the analysis scripts, per-arm configurations, and the result files behind every number reported in the paper.

All experiments use the public uniad_base_e2e checkpoint on the full nuScenes validation split (6,019 frames) with no retraining. UniAD and nuScenes are not redistributed and remain under their own licences.
